paper.title_en: Study of the weak radiative decay $B_c^+\to B_u^{\ast+}γ$
paper.abstract_en: We investigate the rare radiative decay $B_c \to B_u^\astγ$ within the Standard Model by using the instantaneous Bethe-Salpeter (BS) approach. The short distance (SD) $c \to uγ$ penguin, weak annihilation, and long distance (LD) vector meson dominance (VMD) contributions are all included. In the calculation of LD contribution, we use two scenarios, namely the decay width of $ρ$ being set to zero or kept as the experimental value, which gives $\mathrm{Br}_{\rm LD}=5.0\times10^{-9}$ and $7.3\times10^{-8}$, respectively, indicating an important role of $Γ_ρ$ in the calculation. The SD contribution is comparable in magnitude to the LD contributions, but one order larger than the annihilation contribution. This shows the $B_c \to B_u^\astγ$ channel can provide an important way to study the flavor changing neutral current processes of charm quark.
